:::{#def-logarithmic-derivative}
#### Logarithmic derivative

The **logarithmic derivative** $\frac{f'(x)}{f(x)}$ of a function $f$ of a real variable
equals $\dif{}{x}\logf{f(x)}$ by @cor-deriv-log-chain
and measures the rate of change of $f$ relative to its size;
it needs $f(x) > 0$,
and for $f(x) < 0$ the same expression is the derivative of $\logf{\abs{f(x)}}$.

:::
